what: DESIGN_TMPDIR is planned only as a session-id source, not as a ledger root
scenario_or_breakage: Standalone /design launchers can export the right LARCH_TOKEN_SESSION_ID but token-ledger.sh still warns no per-run ledger root set and drops vendor records
suggested_fix: Extend resolve_ledger_path to use DESIGN_TMPDIR as a canonical ledger root after IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR and before SESSION_ENV_PATH, and assert the ledger path is under DESIGN_TMPDIR

what: /design has no planned token-ledger mark rows
scenario_or_breakage: token-report.sh errors on no step marks in ledger, so the new /design cost line is suppressed even after Codex or Cursor records vendor tokens
suggested_fix: Add best-effort token-ledger.sh mark calls in /design after DESIGN_TMPDIR exists, at least one opening mark before external launches, plus a closing/cap mark if needed

what: Cost line on every /design exit path conflicts with nested artifact-only contract
scenario_or_breakage: Nested /design under /implement currently permits only the terminal machine footer after successful plan write; adding another terminal line can break parent orchestration assumptions
suggested_fix: Gate terminal cost-line output to standalone mode when SESSION_ENV_PATH is empty, or explicitly redesign and test the nested contract and parent parser

what: Token report rendering and JSON extraction are left to multiple prompt-side exit paths
scenario_or_breakage: Several /design exits must repeat brittle shell and jq logic, increasing the chance one path emits stale, missing, or malformed cost data
suggested_fix: Move render report, extract counts, quiet-on-empty, and warning behavior into one helper such as emit-design-cost-line.sh, then have each exit path call that helper

what: New harness files are planned without full repo registration
scenario_or_breakage: New scripts/test-token-cost.sh and scripts/test-render-cost-line.sh would need sibling docs and Makefile shard registration; otherwise relevant checks may miss them or agent-lint may flag orphaned files
suggested_fix: Add scripts/test-token-cost.md, scripts/test-render-cost-line.md, Makefile targets/shard entries, docs/linting.md entries, and agent-lint allowlist entries where this repo expects Makefile-only harnesses
